shared_elements: tall vertical stone monument photographed in a museum interior
shallow low-relief carving on a weathered, pitted stone surface
anthropomorphic figure with head and facial features
horizontal band or belt-like divider crossing the surface
justification: Both are weathered, tall stone monuments bearing shallow relief that includes disc motifs, anthropomorphic features and band-like horizontal divisions, and both are shown as museum objects lit from the front. The decisive difference is that A is a flat slab covered edge-to-edge with a crowded, asymmetrical pictorial and glyph-like scene, whereas B is a bulky sculpture in the round whose carving is a sparse, symmetrical arrangement of emblems on a body with an integral head, so the compositional schemes barely correspond.
